label: Macron rises like a Hitler, an Ishmael to the Isaac
description: He reports being warned by the Holy Ghost in visions and dreams that the French president will rise in the days ahead like a Hitler, and that he is an Ishmael to the Isaac, with the Antichrist himself being groomed behind a curtain by four devils who comb his hair and groom his face.

label: A short window to preach the gospel across China and North Korea
description: Seen as theatre drapes parted only in the middle: while the economy shakes and there is uprising and rioting in the Chinese community and moves against the government, a limited opportunity opens for the gospel to be preached across all of China, and later the same in North Korea. He specifies it is not large and does not last long.

label: Harriet Tubman in a purple do-rag, and Black Wall Street
description: He describes seeing an African-American woman in a purple do-rag and a white shirt, which his son then matched to photographs of Harriet Tubman from the Underground Railroad period, and ties it to Black Wall Street and to the Wall Street and New York City words he had been receiving, read as a type rather than a claim about New York.
